title: Spendly V3.1.4 Available
message: Spendly V3.1.4 is now available with critical update detection fixes.
releaseNotes: Critical update notification fix enforcing production manifest fetching over HTTPS
Native Android installed version detection via Capacitor App.getInfo()
Interactive System & Version Diagnostic Modal in Settings with manual re-check option
Detailed update check diagnostics with HTTP status codes and error reporting
Version-specific notification dismissal preventing stale update suppression
